Class MeteorShower

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.MeteorShower
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardInterface, Serializable
public class MeteorShower extends Card implements Serializable
Class that manages the single card meteor shower In the order of representation of the meteors on the card, the leader roll the dices for each meteor to determinate the row or column in which the meteor will hit. If it's a small meteor, the trucker doesn't have to worry if he/she has a well assembled ship, otherwise can use a battery to activate a shield oriented in that direction to protect the ship. If it's a big meteor, the trucker can use, or activate if is double, a cannon to destroy the meteor; a cannon protects only one column or 3 row (his own and the 2 adjacent ones) if rotated;
